scope: Proposition 4.2 (Separating interfaces) of the manuscript “Spectral scalar curvature and Urysohn width in dimension three” (preprints/Spectral-scalar-curvature-and-Urysohn-width-in-dimension-three-October-5-2026/spectral-urysohn-three-manifolds.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 336 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2a0852ff04d11752), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let ℓ ≥ 100, and suppose that {r > ℓ} is nonempty. There are finitely many disjoint smooth compact connected two-sided neat hypersurfaces F1, . . . , Fm in P such that Fi ⊂ {ℓ − 91 < r < ℓ − 18}, diamd Fi ≤ 4π. (4.7) Each Fi separates P. Moreover, P \ S i Fi is the disjoint union of two open sets U+, U−, with o ∈ U+ and {r > ℓ} ⊂ U−.
